purpose: Reduce source uncertainty with bounded public probes before any campaign, bulk acquisition or model fitting.
prohibitions: no bulk or recursive historical download
no fitting and no scientific promotion from probe data

probes.maximum: one offer XLSX plus its one winner XLSX from the same auction; each <=250000 bytes
probes.accept_if: offer and result can be joined at lot or product-delivery stratum without inventing keys
probes.reject_if: winner file is only company names or lacks outcome price/quantity

probes.maximum: one API response <=250000 bytes for one country, one NACE manufacturing target and <=24 months
probes.accept_if: manufacturing-only series and observation status are returned with stable dimension labels
probes.reject_if: query cannot exclude energy/gas or lacks time/status semantics

probes.maximum: one latest monthly XLSX <=3000000 bytes; inspect metadata and at most two sheets
probes.accept_if: port-local monthly physical quantities can be read without imputing totals

probes.maximum: one anonymous Search API response with limit <=10 and fields-only projection
probes.accept_if: physical-supply award notices expose stable CPV/location/value fields; quantity completeness measured separately
probes.reject_if: authentication is demanded or values cannot be linked to a published award

probes.maximum: one public preview response <=500 records and <=250000 bytes for one reporter, month and physical HS code
probes.accept_if: no-auth preview exposes real non-synthetic rows and revision/status metadata
probes.reject_if: only modeled estimates are returned or final-vintage identity is unavailable
